description: This file defines the AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements configuration logic for Azure Storage clustering in Orleans, specifically for silo and client builders. It registers providers and configures TableServiceClient instances based on configuration settings.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that implements provider configuration for Azure Storage clustering in Orleans, for both silo and client builders.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Storage clustering based on provided configuration.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use Azure Storage clustering based on provided configuration.
